name: linux-kernel-analysis
description: Source-only workflows for multi-perspective static analysis of mainline Linux kernel code.

interface.shortDescription: Statically analyze mainline Linux kernel source.
interface.longDescription: A family of source-only workflows for static analysis of mainline Linux kernel boundary contracts, object lifetimes, state and path selection, execution-context handoffs, concurrency, resource flow, failure recovery, and performance mechanisms.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this mainline Linux kernel subsystem from source.
Trace the source-defined execution-context handoffs in this mainline driver.
Derive the boundary contracts of this mainline kernel component.
